description: Backend issue patterns for DatabaseHelper.java analysis

patterns.name: SQL Injection Risk
patterns.description: SQL query constructed with string concatenation instead of prepared statements

patterns.name: Missing AUTO_SERVER in H2 Connection
patterns.description: H2 JDBC connection string missing AUTO_SERVER=TRUE for shared access
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add AUTO_SERVER=TRUE to JDBC connection string for debugging support

patterns.name: Hardcoded Database Credentials
patterns.description: Database credentials hardcoded in source code
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use environment variables or configuration files for credentials
patterns.example_correct:
private static final String USER = System.getenv("DB_USER");
private static final String PASS = System.getenv("DB_PASS");

patterns.name: Resource Leak - Unclosed Connection
patterns.description: Database connection not closed in finally block or try-with-resources
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use try-with-resources or close connection in finally block

patterns.name: Resource Leak - Unclosed Statement
patterns.description: PreparedStatement or Statement not closed properly
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use try-with-resources for automatic resource management

patterns.name: Resource Leak - Unclosed ResultSet
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use try-with-resources for automatic resource management

patterns.name: Missing Input Validation
patterns.fix_suggestion: Validate all inputs before database operations

patterns.name: Missing Transaction Rollback
patterns.description: Transaction without rollback in catch block
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add rollback in catch block for transaction safety

patterns.name: Foreign Key Violation Risk
patterns.description: Delete operation without checking foreign key constraints
patterns.fix_suggestion: Check for dependent records before deletion or use CASCADE
patterns.example_correct:
String checkQuery = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM child WHERE parent_id = ?";
// check count before deleting parent

patterns.name: Duplicate Record Creation
patterns.fix_suggestion: Check for existing records before insertion or use UNIQUE constraints
patterns.example_correct:
String checkQuery = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE email = ?";
// check before inserting

patterns.name: Missing Audit Log
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add audit logging for all data modifications

patterns.name: Missing Permission Check
patterns.description: Data access operation without permission validation
patterns.fix_suggestion: Validate user permissions before data access

patterns.name: Date Format Inconsistency
patterns.fix_suggestion: Use ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd) for date consistency

patterns.name: Null Pointer Risk
patterns.fix_suggestion: Check for null values from ResultSet

patterns.name: Inefficient Query
patterns.fix_suggestion: Specify required columns instead of using SELECT *
patterns.example_correct: SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE ...

patterns.name: Missing Pagination
patterns.description: Large result set query without LIMIT or pagination
patterns.fix_suggestion: Add LIMIT and OFFSET for pagination on large result sets
patterns.example_correct: SELECT * FROM residents ORDER BY id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
